integrity: Proved general statement by monomial rigidity, cyclic rescaling quotient, Burnside, stabilizer and element-idempotent equations; reproducible finite checker corroborates selected cases but does not certify all sizes.
scientific_limitations: Applies to perfect weighted-permutation evolution algebras over finite fields, with F_q-linear isomorphisms; not all evolution algebras. Related 2020 preprint full text unavailable. Results are self-reviewed only; independent audit is not performed.
title: Finite-field weighted permutation evolution algebras: exact cycle, symmetry and idempotent classifications
